title: Run a performance improvement process
summary: When documented performance concerns need a supported improvement plan beyond routine feedback. A fair, documented review outcome with support delivered and any further action separately authorized.
outcomes: A fair, documented review outcome with support delivered and any further action separately authorized.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When documented performance concerns need a supported improvement plan beyond routine feedback.

parts.title: Assemble factual performance evidence
parts.guidance: Gather the role expectations, prior feedback, work examples and relevant dates. Separate capability, conduct, workload and unclear objectives, and restrict the record to those responsible for the process.

execution.rationale: Prepare or reconcile the specified private evidence and documents; external changes and decisions use their own approved steps.

parts.title: Assess causes and the appropriate process
parts.guidance: The manager and HR hear the employee's perspective and review support, health, disability or workplace factors with qualified advice where needed. Choose the applicable informal or formal route without prejudging dismissal.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Assess causes and the appropriate process

parts.title: Agree a specific improvement and support plan
parts.guidance: Set observable expectations, resources, coaching, review points and responsibilities. Check the plan is realistic for the role and circumstances and explain how progress and concerns will be discussed.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

approval.scope: Agree a specific improvement and support plan

parts.title: Deliver support and review evidence
parts.guidance: Hold the agreed check-ins, provide the promised resources and record both progress and unresolved barriers. Reassess the plan when facts change rather than manufacturing a record for a predetermined outcome.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

parts.title: Decide and document the outcome
parts.guidance: The authorized manager and HR review the evidence and applicable process before deciding whether to close, extend or escalate. Any contractual change, disciplinary action or termination requires its own reviewed authority and communication.

execution.rationale: The accountable person performs the decision, expert assessment or personal interaction described in this step. Supporting preparation does not authorize that act.

verify.how: A fair, documented review outcome with support delivered and any further action separately authorized.

notes.text: This is an operational coordination guide. Confirm the applicable company facts, contracts and jurisdictions before acting. Qualified advisers own legal, tax, safety or regulatory determinations and any required professional work. The cited authorities describe their named jurisdictions or frameworks; their rules are not asserted for other countries. External actions require approval for the specific action.
